class.description: Headland turns chosen as geometry rather than searched for: a u-turn where the next row is at least a turning diameter away, a bulb where it is nearer and the headland is deep enough to loop round the outside, and a three-point turn where it is not. The depth available is read off the costmap at the row end rather than assumed.

Follows a path at the curvature the path already implies, commanding the steering angle outright and using feedback only to trim it. Brakes to a stop at a change of direction, which an Ackermann machine cannot make while rolling.

Covers an orchard aisle by aisle. Holds the mission state -- where the rows are, what order to take them in, what has been covered -- and leaves the driving of a single leg to a behaviour tree of stock Nav2 nodes.
